blocks.tamil_translation: company of the Prophet ﷺ and said, “Some thoughts arise in our hearts. We consider it a sin to utter them with the tongue.’ The Prophet ﷺ asked, “Do you truly hate to utter them with the tongue?” They said, “Yes!” The Prophet ﷺ said, “This is clear Iman!” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates this.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- Let alone believing these whisperings, you consider even uttering them with the tongue a sin. Considering it a sin in this way is itself the sign of complete Iman.
(Nawawi)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: أَكْثِرُوا مِنْ شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لاٰ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُحَالَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابو يعلي باسناد جيد قوي، الترغيب:٢ /٤١٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Say the testimony “La ilaha illallah” abundantly before a barrier comes between you and it (because of death, illness and the like).”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُثْمَانَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ مَاتَ وَهُوَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ لاٰ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب الدليل علي ان من مات ......، رقم:١٣٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Uthman (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever dies knowing with certainty that there is no god but Allah will enter Jannah.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ ﵁ قَالَ:قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ:مَنْ مَاتَ وَهُوَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّ اللهَ حَقٌّ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ.
